population.value: adults at risk of type 2 diabetes (i.e. with overweight or obesity and a score of ≥15 on the Australian type 2 diabetes risk assessment tool)

intervention.value: Time-restricted eating (TRE) (9 h, self-selected eating window, last eating occasion by 19:00 hours)

primary_findings.quote: At 4 months, TRE was non-inferior but not superior to IDG for HbA1c (mean [95% CI]: -0.22 [-0.72, 0.30] mmol/mol; -0.02 [-0.07, 0.03]%; p=0.40).
